author: Numberz_
body:
I talked to Peachy about this a few weeks ago I don't know if he relayed the message. Anyway my suggestion is kinda simple (or at lest I think it is) when I was playing Walls on another server I found that they had an awesome anti team killing plugin or something. All the players on teams get resistance 100 for the ten minutes before the walls drop, this prevents players from being team killed or dying.

Hopefully this idea could get added, I think it would be a great feature. Thanks!

replies.author: kycrafft
replies.body: As you can't actually do direct damage to teammates (ex: via sword), team killers resort to using TNT, lava, spleefing, potions, and fire, among other things. Personally damage between teammates subtracts from the overall aspect of the game as reckless and negative behavior will directly impact your performance in the game. It also happens to be very hard to deal with as you have little control over the situation, which may even escalate tensions further. I don't know exactly what you are implying, but I think that teamkilling creates a negative atmosphere in the game.

replies.author: kycrafft
replies.body: Still, the ease of teamkilling may be too tempting for some players. Unless it's in a tournament setting, I can't really trust someone to not deal damage to me behind my back. This may be the opinion of other players, who might rate and call out someone for teamkilling even if it was an accident. This sort of thing leads to grudges, bad blood and negativity amongst the community. I personally think that there are too many negative aspects of this.
